reviews.notes:
Independent AI evidence review against landed scope public-api-empty-face v1 only. Directly checked sealed original artifacts, not merely submitted metadata: source/installed MacBinary resource-fork and component joins; configured Copl/FCB file identities; native invocation/procedure/variant/hilite/value0, empty title, fixed Rect, active/enabled state, full effective clip and white background; compiled source invocation and capture glue; producer build and boot-volume hashes.

Original full-frame PNG equals retained 1228800-byte producer RGBA. Submitted160x80 port and96x36 context are exact integer crops at recorded frame coordinates; entire80x20 face retained. Both original frames viewed. Native excerpt/redaction lines and palette/gamma table bytes checked directly. Sanitized package excludes original engine/OS/ROM/emulator/font/app payloads; included binary artifacts are only observed palette and gamma tables. No Scriptoscope rendering or substituted assets generate these original images.

Windows95v9 palette/producer conditions bracket the mapping batch AFTER Draw1Control. This is accepted as recorded post-draw observational context, not a pre-draw/bracketing claim or general color-transform proof.

Configured scheme is not selected-resource/cache ownership. Font realization, complete patch/base/search order, selected provider/cache and private default state remain explicitly unknown. No public default API was invoked; this does not prove private default flags false. Producer semantic release and clean-shutdown acknowledgment remain unestablished.

Accepted only as composited-face observation on the recorded opaque background. No alpha/mask, font independence, automatic sizing, other states, margins/rings, private painter or whole-device fidelity claim. ZERO requirements verified; ALL FIVE request requirements remain unresolved and whole request evidence-incomplete. No renderer comparison or ledger promotion is part of this attestation.

reviews.notes:

Candidate image, source/installation/configured-file, native invocation/state, clip/palette/gamma and capture bindings match the previously independently reviewed sealed v10 observation. Sanitized retained lines and redaction digests bind to that observation; full frame and exact port/context PNG hashes are unchanged. Original producer RGBA/frame equality and integer crops were established in that prior factual review, not inferred from modern renderer output.

Actual public NewControl(proc0), Draw1Control and HiliteControl(10) are recorded with variant/value0, empty fixed80x20 Rect and active window. Hilite10 means logical control highlight, not a physical held mouse gesture. Hilite255 means disabled control in an active window, not an inactive window. No public default API was invoked; private default flags remain unknown.

Conditions bracket the public draw. The v9 measured-profile relationship is cross-run equality of recorded palette/gamma bytes only, not identical hidden environment or a universal color-transfer algorithm. Modern comparison files were not used to authenticate original capture pixels or determine this review verdict.

The inherited System7 subject in the original Win95 wrapper is incorrect and retained with a correction sidecar. Independent visible/native V10W nonce and sequence, public Copl/FCB Windows95 fileID440 and exact stopped canonical scheme fork establish the configured Windows95 environment. The static wrapper label is not theme/state authority.

Configured file and actual CDEF/WDEF wrapper identities do not establish selected original cicn/cinf/private painter or cache ownership. Font realization, complete patch/base/search order, selected provider/cache and private default state remain explicitly unknown. OS identity is a copied preboot volume hash, not an isolated System-file hash; producer semantic release and clean-shutdown acknowledgment remain unestablished.

Accepted only as the recorded composited face on an opaque white background. No alpha/mask, font independence, automatic sizing, other states, margins/rings, physical gesture, inactive-window or whole-device claim. ZERO requirements verified; ALL FIVE target requirements remain unresolved and the whole request remains evidence-incomplete. No ledger promotion. Original engine/OS/ROM/font/emulator/app payloads are excluded from the candidate intake; retained original binary support is limited to palette/gamma tables.
